questions.q: What did this lighthouse's three flashes tell every captain?
options: You are near the island — stand off

questions.q: How did the keeper repaint the tower's seaward wall?
options: Swinging thirty feet up in a bosun's chair, gulls hovering at eye level
Standing in the supply winch basket
He left it for the mainland painters

questions.q: What was in the parcel from the keeper's sister?
options: A knitted navy jumper and a fruitcake
